verdict.rationale: Robots.txt compliance and rate limiting are a fair axis for a web crawler, but nothing in the evidence pack documents either capability in Crawl4AI. The only related items are community comments listing robots/ToS and rate limiting as production concerns and calling the tool a foundation 'if you're willing to own the policy layer', which suggests users handle this themselves. The proxy-retry and parallel-crawling features cited elsewhere do not address politeness controls.
